sections.text: Introduction

The Micro Ohmmeter is designed for measuring the resistance of contacts on
busbars and circuit breakers. The measurement is made at a high current,
typically 100 amperes DC. The voltage drop across a contact under test is
compared to the voltage drop across a known internal shunt resistance and the
result is displayed.

Note: This step by step instruction is for
Micro Ohmmeter "Multi-Amp" Model 830250.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area is required,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Breaker must be proper isolated and grounded.
Breaker must be in "closed" position.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: "Multi-Amp" Model 830250.
Safety helmet, shoes .... etc

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Calibration

Using the power cord, connect the instrument to a suitable 220 Volt AC
 supply
Plug in the heavy current cables and connect the 2 large clamps together

Connect the smaller potential cables and shorten it out by connecting the
 large clamps together
Set the Current Range Selector Switch to 1 Amp
Set the Resistance Range Selector Switch to the middle position

Using the power cord, connect the instrument to a suitable 220 Volt AC
 supply
Plug in the heavy current cables and connect the 2 large clamps together

Connect the smaller potential cables and shorten it out by connecting the
 large clamps together
Set the Current Range Selector Switch to 1 Amp
Set the Resistance Range Selector Switch to the middle position

Turn the power switch to the "on" position. The digital display
 should now read +/- 00.0 and the pointer of the analogue test current meter
 should be in the green area and the "m Ohm" LED should be on. To
 verify proper operation, connect the 60 A DC current shunt as shown in the
 drawing below.

sections.text: Set the Test Current Selector Switch to 10 Amps
Set the Resistance Range Selector Switch to mid position

Turn the power switch to "on" position. The digital read-out
 should show 0.99 and the milli Ohm LED should be on

Switch the Resistance Range Selector Switch to high "up"
 position. The digital read-out should now show approx 995 and the micro Ohm

sections.text: Note:

items: The potential cables must always be connected inside of the current cables
Maintain always same polarity (red current cable to red potential cable)

The instrument will give the highest accuracy on the 50 and 100 ampere
ranges, however the duty cycle at this range is one minute "on" 10
minutes "off"

The instrument requires a 2 minute warm-up time to stabilize the metering
circuit

The breaker contacts are generally in good condition if the obtained reading
does not exceed 100 micro ohm.
